{"thought": "The test failed as expected, confirming the bug. The `AssertionError` shows that `result` was `'[x]\na.b = {}c = 3\n'` while `expected` was `'[x]\na.b = {}\nc = 3\n'`. This is exactly the behavior described in the issue. I can now provide the test file.", "final_test": "import tomlkit

def test_inline_table_newline_after_add():
    v = tomlkit.loads("""[x]\na.b = {}""")
    v["x"]["c"] = 3
    result = tomlkit.dumps(v)
    expected = """[x]\na.b = {}\nc = 3\n"""
    assert result == expected"}
